### Imports

```{r}
library("stringr")
library("DESeq2")
library("org.Mm.eg.db")
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("ggrepel")
library("ggpubr")
library("writexl")
library("readxl")
library("tidyverse")
```

```{r}
date_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
date_str

set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
# List files
filenames <- list.files("../GSE158799_count_excels", full.names = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Drop P30
filenames <- filenames[-grep("P30", filenames)]
```

```{r}
counts_list <- list()

for (fname in filenames) {
  info <- read_excel(fname, col_names = TRUE)
  counts_list[[fname]] <- info
}
```

```{r}
combined_counts <- counts_list %>% reduce(left_join, by = "Gene")
combined_counts <- as.data.frame(combined_counts)
rownames(combined_counts) <- combined_counts$Gene
combined_counts$Gene <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Create an annotation table
annot_rows <- colnames(combined_counts)

# Only P14 and P17 contained samples were kept
p14_samples_idx <- grep("P14", annot_rows)
p17_samples_idx <- grep("P17", annot_rows)

annot_days <- rep("P17", length(annot_rows))
annot_days[p14_samples_idx] <- "P14"

OIR_samples <- grep("OIR", annot_rows)

annot_groups <- rep("Normal", length(annot_rows))
annot_groups[OIR_samples] <- "OIR"

annot_table <- data.frame("Timepoint" = annot_days,
                          "Group" = annot_groups,
                          row.names = annot_rows,
                          stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Check that annot rows and count cols match
identical(rownames(annot_table), colnames(combined_counts))
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = combined_counts,
                              colData = annot_table,
                              design = ~ Timepoint + Group + Timepoint:Group)
```

```{r}
# Suggested pre-filtering by DESeq2 vignette, smallest sample group is 2
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
dds <- dds[keep,]

```


```{r}
# Explicit factor reference levels
dds$Timepoint <- relevel(dds$Timepoint, ref = "P14")
dds$Group <- relevel(dds$Group, ref = "Normal")
```

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r}
resultsNames(dds)
```
```{r}
# P14 OIR vs Normal, with normal ref
p14_res <- as.data.frame(results(dds,
                                 contrast = c("Group", "OIR", "Normal")))
```

```{r}
p17_res <- as.data.frame(results(dds,
                                 contrast = list(
                                   c("Group_OIR_vs_Normal",
                                     "TimepointP17.GroupOIR")
                                 )))
```

```{r}
# Design construction
dds$simple_group <- factor(paste0(dds$Timepoint, dds$Group))
design(dds) <- ~ simple_group
dds <- DESeq(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```
```{r}
p14_res_simple <- as.data.frame(results(dds, 
                                 contrast = c("simple_group",
                                              "P14OIR", "P14Normal")))
```

```{r}
p17_res_simple <- as.data.frame(results(dds, 
                                 contrast = c("simple_group",
                                              "P17OIR", "P17Normal")))
```

```{r}
P14_res_filt <- p14_res_simple[abs(p14_res_simple$log2FoldChange) > 1 & p14_res_simple$padj < 0.05 & complete.cases(p14_res_simple), ]
P14_res_filt["gene"] <- rownames(P14_res_filt)
```

```{r}
P17_res_filt <- p17_res_simple[abs(p17_res_simple$log2FoldChange) > 1 & p17_res_simple$padj < 0.05 & complete.cases(p17_res_simple), ]
P17_res_filt["gene"] <- rownames(P17_res_filt)
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(list("P14 OIR Bulk RNA filtered" = P14_res_filt,
                "P17 OIR Bulk RNA filtered" = P17_res_filt),
           path = "./OIR_Bulk_RNAseq_DEGs_20261030.xlsx")
```

```{r}
# Add genes as its own column since writexl doesn't seem to provide a way to preserve it
p14_res_simple["gene"] <- rownames(p14_res_simple)
p17_res_simple["gene"] <- rownames(p17_res_simple)
```

```{r}
genes_of_interest <- c("Cd93", "Igfbp7", "Mmrn2")

for (gene in genes_of_interest) {
  
  main_title <- str_glue("GSE158799 - {gene}")
  
  plotCounts(dds = dds,
           gene = gene,
           intgroup = c("simple_group"),
           main = main_title,
           xlab = "Group")
}


```
```{r}
gene <- "Mmrn2"

test <- plotCounts(dds = dds,
           gene = gene,
           intgroup = c("simple_group"),
           main = main_title,
           xlab = "Group",
           returnData = TRUE)
test <- test[grep("P17", test$simple_group), ]
test$simple_group <- sub("P17", "", test$simple_group)

box_p <- ggplot(test,
       aes(x = simple_group,
           y = log2(count + 0.5),
           fill = simple_group),) + 
  #scale_y_log10() + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3) +
  ggtitle(gene) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized count") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          face = "bold"
        ),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          face = "bold"
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold.italic"
        ))

ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE158799_P17_boxplot_", date_str, ".png"),
               plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
             width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE158799_P17_boxplot_", date_str, ".pdf"),
               plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
             width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
deseq_plotcounts_to_boxplot <- function(gene,
                                        dds,
                                        save=FALSE,
                                        y_ax_lab_text_size=10,
                                        y_ax_tick_text_size=10,
                                        x_ax_text_size=10,
                                        title_text_size=10,
                                        timepoint="P17",
                                        ylim_up=1000) {
  
  if (gene %in% rownames(dds) == FALSE) {
    print(paste0(gene, " not present."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  count_data <- plotCounts(dds = dds,
           gene = gene,
           intgroup = c("simple_group"),
           main = main_title,
           xlab = "Group",
           returnData = TRUE)
  count_data <- count_data[grep(timepoint, count_data$simple_group), ]
  count_data$simple_group <- sub(timepoint, "", count_data$simple_group)
  
  box_p <- ggplot(count_data,
       aes(x = simple_group,
           y = count,
           fill = simple_group),) + 
  #scale_y_log10() + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.3) +
  ggtitle(paste0(gene, " ", timepoint)) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Normalized count") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_text(
          face = "bold", size = y_ax_lab_text_size
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = y_ax_tick_text_size
        ),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          face = "bold", size = x_ax_text_size
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
          face = "bold.italic", size = title_text_size
        ))
  
  if (ylim_up != 1000) {
    box_p <- box_p + ylim(0, ylim_up)
  }
  
  print(box_p)
  
  if (save) {
    ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE158799_boxplot_", timepoint, "_", date_str, ".png"),
               plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
             width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(paste0(gene, "_GSE158799_boxplot_", timepoint, "_", date_str, ".pdf"),
                   plot = box_p, path = "boxplots",
                 width = 4, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```
